summary: Phase B (Agentic Tools + File Upload + Sandbox Code Execution) validated end-to-end with 18 new pytest tests added to /app/backend/tests/test_phase_b.py. Full regression suite: 52/52 tests pass (34 Phase A + 18 Phase B). Verified: GET /api/agent/tools lists 6 tools with correct credit costs (web_search=5, read_url=3, read_file=2, list_files=1, write_file=4, execute_python=10); multipart file upload happy path (.txt) → DB doc created with conv_id='_pending'; rejection of .exe (400 'type not allowed') and >10MB (400 'too large'); GET /api/files/upload/{file_id} returns original bytes; agent execute_python deterministic (Fibonacci) with credits=10 and ok=true; write_file produces downloadable artifact via /api/files/artifact/{conv_id}/{file_id}; GET /api/files/conversation/{conv_id} returns {uploads, artifacts}; attachment workflow (upload→chat with attachment_ids→agent calls read_file→answer mentions content from file; upload doc conv_id migrates from '_pending' to real conv_id; file physically moved on disk); execute_python 10s timeout enforced (whole request <90s, tool event ok=false); execute_python sandbox network attempt handled gracefully; agent loop bounded (tool_events <= 40 even under tool-spam prompts; MAX_ROUNDS=8 enforced); credit deduction precision (1000 → 1000-(8+sum(tool_credits))); tool_events persisted in db.messages and returned by GET /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/messages; agent lock follow-ups still trigger tool-calling; general mode never invokes tools and stays free.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 884 lines — still strongly recommended to split into routers (auth, chat, files, credits, admin, agent_tools). Single-file growth is now actively hurting maintainability.

Agent tool dispatcher in server.py:_call_llm uses session_id as the conv_id for tool execution. That coincidentally works because /chat/send passes conv_id as session_id, but the LlmChat session_id is conceptually distinct — would break if session_id ever changes. Recommend passing conv_id explicitly to _call_llm.

Insufficient credits behavior with tools is asymmetric: base agent cost (8) is gated upfront (402), but tool credits are deducted post-hoc via $inc, so balance CAN go negative (e.g. user with 10 credits invoking write_file+execute_python ends with -7). Spec says current behavior is acceptable but document it; consider $max:{credits:0} floor or pre-tool-call balance checks.
write_file artifact filename sanitization in tools.py strips most special chars but allows spaces — could lead to subtle URL/display issues. Consider underscoring spaces.

execute_python subprocess env strips PATH/LANG but still inherits everything else (no PYTHONPATH wipe, no resource limits like RLIMIT_AS). A malicious user could still fork-bomb or allocate large memory inside the 10s window. For production-grade sandbox, use nsjail/firejail or a container.
list_conversation_files iterates artifact dir synchronously inside an async handler — fine for small dirs, but blocks event loop for large ones. Wrap in asyncio.to_thread.

Upload file move in /chat/send (lines ~494-503) reads UPLOAD_DIR via late import and renames synchronously inside async path; also vulnerable if old_path missing or race — currently silently skips. Add logging.
find_file matches by prefix file_id + '__' — collision-safe due to UUID, but no explicit double-underscore split protection if filename contains '__'.

Agent loop final response: when MAX_ROUNDS is hit but tool_calls still pending, the model's last tool_calls round is processed but the loop exits without a final assistant turn — response.content fallback is the helper Bangla string, which may hide the truncation from users. Consider sending a final 'no-more-tools' system nudge.
GET /api/agent/tools is public (no auth). Fine for transparency but means anyone can enumerate cost structure — acceptable per spec but worth noting.
Welcome bonus + pricing duplication of constants (COST_GENERAL, COST_AGENT_BASE referenced in both /credits/pricing and chat_send) — extract to a config module.
test_credentials: Per-session bootstrapped via mongosh into DB_NAME=test_database (conftest._create_session). One throwaway normal user (credits=1000) per session; admin user (credits=5000) for admin tests. All cleaned up on teardown.
seed_data_creation: TestFreeChatLimit (Phase A) seeds 100 user messages prefixed 'TEST_seed_' to trigger 429 path then cleans up. Phase B tests upload disposable .txt files into uploads/_pending and uploads/{conv_id}; created artifacts live under /app/backend/artifacts/{conv_id}/. Each Phase B agent test resets the test user's balance to 1000 via mongosh before running.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B locked in. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (~3 min wall time). LLM+tool-calling tests are slow (15-65s each). web_search tool is NOT covered by an explicit test (DDG rate-limit flakiness); if you want to add one, retry once and mark flaky. Filesystem artifacts under /app/backend/uploads/ and /app/backend/artifacts/ accumulate across test runs — safe to wipe between full regressions. Agent loop MAX_ROUNDS=8 is hard-coded in server.py:_call_llm. Note: balance can go negative with tool credits (see code review item #3) — this is documented spec behavior, not a bug.
